title: Platform Resource Identity and Brand Governance shadow contracts

phases.objective: Publish deterministic no-secret identity and operation contracts with a Brand shadow resolver while keeping authority, grants, credentials, migration, provider calls, and Production disabled.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Identity and operation governance decisions are deterministic, privacy-safe, and fail closed on ambiguity or unsafe effect floors.
steps: Load the identity, Brand resolution, and operation governance schemas.
Resolve exact, probable, none, conflict, and ambiguous Brand candidates.
Validate tenant filtering and identity-only disclosure.
Validate internal, external, destructive, and commercial operation effect floors.
Verify caller input cannot lower registered risk or approval.
assertions: No identity or relationship result implies authority.
Known Brand Create does not require tool discovery.
External and destructive effects retain their risk, approval, and readback floors.
No DB connection, migration, credential read, provider call, external send, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Run separately authorized shadow parity and repository readback before any runtime authority.
Promote only after explicit authority, migration, security, canary, and exact runtime readback.
